summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine director/PDMR share disposals by two managers (Taylor Wright, Global Co-Head of Investment Banking, and Taalib Shaah, Group Chief Risk Officer) on the London Stock Exchange. The disposals are normal-course insider transactions, not a special situation event. The filing is a standard notification of share dealings by persons discharging managerial responsibilities under UK rules, furnished to the SEC as a foreign private issuer report. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change arising from this filing.
